You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important in the failure of the Schlieffen Plan were decisions made by military leaders? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was the use of aircraft to the development of military tactics in the First World War?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was the use of Article 48 of the Constitution to the survival of the Weimar Republic
up to 1933? Explain your answer.
How significant was Hitler’s leadership to the development of the Nazi Party in the 1920s? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was Bloody Sunday as a cause of opposition to Tsarist rule by 1914? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was the role of foreign nations to the outcome of the Russian Civil War? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was the First World War to the US economy in the 1920s? Explain your answer.
How significant was winning the vote as a factor in changing the lives of women in the USA in the
1920s? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were the actions of Chiang Kai-shek in determining the outcome of the Chinese
Civil War? Explain your answer.
How significant was the Great Leap Forward as a reason why Mao launched the Cultural Revolution?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was segregation in housing as an aspect of the lives of the non-white population in
South Africa before 1948? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Nelson Mandela in the opposition to apartheid by 1963? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the United Nations Organisation to developments in Palestine by 1949? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant were the actions of Egypt and Syria in causing conflict in the Middle East between
1956 and 1973? Explain your answer. [40]
